prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all tested change types (adoption redesign, choose_path layout, finish new_screen, home wait_info, and sign_in hint) as each category has only one test so far.
Predictions were generally too high, overestimating positive impact for 4 out of 5 tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +7.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -8.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split View Pet Creation Canvas: Redesigns photo submission into a side-by-side split view showing photo quality tips alongside live preview feedback. (why: Adoption stage has low conversion (66.2%) and long completion times (mean 1017s), while 3 support tickets complained custom pets failed or looked wrong.)
1: [home, wait_info] Pet Render Detailed Progress Indicator: Displays explicit progress status steps and estimated remaining time while generating the desktop pet sprite. (why: Home waiting stage has a mean time of 2336s, causing uncertainty over whether generation has frozen or is progressing normally.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Restoration Guidance: Adds an advisory message explaining how signing in preserves existing pet data across reinstallations and devices. (why: 8 support emails (the single largest issue category) reported missing or reset pets after signing back into an account.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Control Callout Copy: Rewrites the final home intro copy to emphasize basic mouse shortcuts for controlling and dismissing the pet. (why: Finish conversion is 64.8% and multiple users wrote support about not knowing how to control or hide the pet once spawned.)
4: [home, notification] Background Generation Completion Alert: Enables desktop system notifications when generation completes so users can minimize the app while waiting. (why: Home wait time averages over 38 minutes (2336s mean), leading users to multitask away and abandon the app before completion.)

scores.note: Adoption has low conversion (66.2%) and support evidence; redesigns showed +7.1% prior lift but require high implementation effort.
Home step conversion is relatively high (81.3%); previous wait_info test resulted in a -1.0% drop.
Supported by the largest email complaint volume (8 tickets) and easy to implement via copy/config.
Finish step loses 35.2% of users; addressing control confusion via copy is simple and low cost.
Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s), but lacks direct support email evidence and needs platform release.
